── MARISOL'S WEEK ──
Marisol is training for a second marathon, the Wexley Lakes Marathon, aiming to break 3:45 after a 4:02 debut. Marisol runs five days a week, with a session on Wednesday, the long run on Sunday and Monday and Friday off, and ran about 30 miles a week before this build.
Recent weeks: 27, 37, 53, 40 mi
This week: 42 mi over 5 runs.
Feeling: "Anxious about the new date."
Asks: "The race got moved two weeks earlier, to October 18, because of the bridge works. That's three weeks from today. I've only done one 20. Do I still have time for my 22-miler?"

── THE DRAFT ──
Tells Marisol: You hit every session as planned and your 17-miler held steady to the end, so the race moving up changes the shape of the next…
Answers: (1) No, skip the 22-miler. … (2) You already have a 20 and a 17 in the bank, both run strong and controlled. One more long run of 16 mi with marathon-pace miles on Sun Oct 4 gives you the specific work you need, then we taper.
Next week:
Mon: rest. Full day off to absorb the 17-miler.
Tue: easy, 6 mi, heart rate under 145, flat. Shake out the legs with nothing more.
Wed: quality, 8 mi with 4 mi at 8:35/mi in the middle, 1 mi easy warm-up and cool-down…
Thu: easy, 5 mi, heart rate under 145, conversational. Recovery between the two hard days.
Fri: rest. Protect Sunday.
Sat: easy, 4 mi, with 4 x 20-second strides at the end. Keeps the legs sharp for the…
Sun: long, 16 mi, easy for 4 mi, then 6 mi at 8:35/mi, then 6 mi easy. Final…
